gemini.prompt_template:
Today is {today}. I already have these art and design stories from RSS feeds: {covered_summary}

Search for creative inspiration from today or this week that is NOT already covered above. Be specific and editorial — no listicles, no tool comparison articles, no auction price news.

Focus on exactly these four areas:
- painting_studio: working painters and their practice — artist spotlights, painting techniques, studio process, exhibition reviews with real artistic depth, what painters are making right now
- creative_mind: how artists think — creative process essays, artist interviews, psychology of creativity, the mental and emotional side of making things, creative block, craft and discipline
- tech_art: where technology genuinely intersects art — generative and computational art worth knowing, creative coding, AI art that is artistically interesting (not tool reviews or comparisons)
- ux_interface: notable UX/UI design work, interface patterns worth studying, design systems, typography in use, visual direction — real work and real decisions, not theory

DO NOT include URLs. Return JSON with 4 keys, each with 2-3 story objects (title, summary in 2 sentences, source name, date):
{"painting_studio":[],"creative_mind":[],"tech_art":[],"ux_interface":[]}
Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown.
